status: Correctness and overhead fixes validated; four workers still slower in one matched pair. No 16-worker performance run.
interpretation: Sparse selection and transient batch preparation remove the large avoidable startup/storage costs. Remaining scheduling, copying, preparation and replay costs still outweigh parallel work on this workload; no claim of speedup. Generic IR conversion and class discovery remain serial. This measurement does not isolate the remaining costs.
instrumentation: Identical perf dummy:u --no-samples task-event recording in both runs; no CPU sampling; fresh database per run. Historical initial-prototype comparisons use a different compiler/stdlib and are not controlled speedup measurements.
